title: Sound System Design & Integration
description: We design and integrate sound systems that deliver consistent coverage, clarity, and reliability across a wide range of environments. Every system is engineered to suit the acoustics and functional requirements of the space, ensuring optimal performance for both background and high-energy applications.
offerings: Distributed audio systems for uniform sound coverage
Line array and high-performance speaker systems
Background music (BGM) and foreground audio solutions
Multi-zone audio control with independent routing
DSP configuration, system tuning, and calibration
Amplifier and speaker matching for efficiency and longevity
Integration with automation and control platforms
Upgrade and retrofit solutions for existing systems

title: Acoustic Design & Treatment
description: We focus on improving how sound behaves within a space by addressing reflections, reverberation, and external noise interference. Our acoustic solutions are tailored to enhance speech intelligibility, musical clarity, and overall listening comfort.
offerings: Detailed room acoustic analysis and assessment
Reverberation time (RT60) optimization
Sound isolation and noise leakage control
Custom acoustic panel design (wall, ceiling, bass traps)
Diffusion and absorption treatment planning
Vibration and structural noise control
Acoustic solutions for studios, auditoriums, and commercial spaces
Coordination with interior design for aesthetic integration

title: Video Solutions (Conferencing & Signage)
description: We provide integrated video systems that support communication, collaboration, and visual engagement. Our solutions are designed for ease of use, reliability, and seamless integration into daily operations.
offerings: Video conferencing systems for boardrooms and meeting spaces
Hybrid meeting and collaboration environments
Digital signage for branding, information, and advertising
LED walls, display panels, and projection systems
AV over IP and centralized video distribution
Touch panel and app-based control systems
Content management systems for signage networks
Integration with existing IT and network infrastructure

title: Lighting Design
description: We design lighting systems that enhance the visual character of a space while maintaining functionality and energy efficiency. Our approach balances aesthetics with control and adaptability.
offerings: Architectural lighting design for indoor and outdoor spaces
Ambient, task, and accent lighting solutions
Stage and performance lighting setups
DMX-based intelligent lighting systems
Scene-based lighting control and automation
Energy-efficient LED lighting solutions
Lighting integration with AV and control systems
Custom lighting solutions for themed environments
